findings.current: “Zhonghua Development Training is a project we created with our whole hearts. It is completely safe, and its results are certain. Wu Heixing, who is the same age, is doing very well too.”
findings.defect: “Completely safe” replaces the narrower claim that the program has thorough safety measures, while “created with our whole hearts” is an unnatural rendering of the painstaking effort invested in its development.
findings.rationale: The source asserts thorough precautions and dependable effectiveness, not absolute freedom from danger.
findings.replacement: “Zhonghua Development Training is a project we developed with painstaking care. Its safety measures are thorough, and its effectiveness is proven. Wu Heixing, who is the same age, is doing well too.”
findings.source: ‘중화 육성 훈련은 심혈을 기울여 제작한 프로젝트입니다. 안전도 철저하고, 효과도 확실합니다. 같은 나이인 우헤이싱도 잘 해내고 있고요.’

findings.current: “Wh-What? No. I just thought that if you like it, then anything… Ah!”
findings.defect: The English is grammatically incomplete in a way that obscures Lei Fei’s accommodating response: he is saying that anything is fine if it is what Wu Heixing wants.
findings.rationale: This preserves the interruption while making the intended conciliatory meaning intelligible.
findings.replacement: “Huh? No. I just… whatever you want is fine with me—ah!”
findings.source: ‘어어? 아닌데. 난 그냥 네가 좋다면 뭐든…… 앗!’

findings.defect: The reply loses both the stammer and the conspicuously stiff military speech pattern that prompts and confirms the woman’s observation about how he talks.
findings.rationale: The source uses a characteristic military-style sentence ending, an important register cue in this awkward courtship scene.

findings.current: When he came to his senses, he was standing dazed in a hospital room with a bright bouquet of flowers in his arms.
findings.defect: The draft changes the physical action from entering the hospital room to already standing inside it.
findings.rationale: 들어서고 있었다 specifically depicts him in the act of entering.
findings.replacement: When he came to his senses, he was walking dazedly into a hospital room with a bright bouquet of flowers in his arms.
findings.source: 정신을 차렸을 때 그는 화사한 꽃 한 다발을 품에 안은 채 멍하니 병실에 들어서고 있었다.

findings.current: “Honey, honey! Did you hear that? He’s already calling for his daddy. Isn’t our baby a genius?”
findings.defect: The draft calls the baby male, contradicting the later explicit identification of the child as his daughter; the Korean uses no gendered pronoun here.
findings.rationale: The source leaves the child’s sex unstated in this line, and the chapter later reveals that the child is a daughter.
findings.replacement: “Honey, honey! Did you hear that? Our baby’s already saying ‘Dada.’ Could our baby be a genius?”
findings.source: ‘여보. 여보! 방금 들었어? 벌써 아빠를 부르다니, 우리 애 천재 아닐까?’

findings.current: “Gaoping District? Keep trying to contact them, and in case of emergency, assemble the Second Regiment and send them out.”
findings.defect: “In case of emergency” makes deployment conditional on a future emergency, whereas the source orders the regiment mobilized and dispatched immediately as a precaution.
findings.rationale: 만일을 대비해 gives the reason for the present deployment; it does not postpone deployment until another condition is met.
findings.replacement: “Gaoping District? Keep trying to contact them, and mobilize and deploy the Second Regiment as a precaution.”
findings.source: ‘가오핑구? 계속해서 연락 취하고, 만일을 대비해 2연대 소집해 출동시킨다.’

findings.current: The black knight—or rather, Lei Fei—had fallen with only one strike left before defeat. Now, tremendous mana surged from his entire body.
findings.defect: “Before defeat” adds a definite interpretation and plot consequence absent from the source, which only says that one strike remained while he lay fallen.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the source’s phrasing without specifying whose strike remained or declaring that defeat was necessarily imminent.
findings.replacement: The black knight—or rather, Lei Fei—who had fallen with one strike still remaining, now erupted with tremendous mana from his entire body.
findings.source: 일격을 남겨 둔 채 쓰러져 있던 검은 기사, 아니 레이페이의 전신에서 엄청난 마력이 솟구쳤다.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it introduces one factual contradiction about the child’s sex, overstates the training program’s safety, alters the rationale for deploying the Second Regiment, and loses several smaller action and register details.
